# Layla

> Free, privacy-first web push notifications. Drop one line of JS on your
> site and start sending browser push notifications. No email, no trackers,
> no cookies. A 16-digit code is your entire account.

Layla is a free web push notification service. It has no signup form, no
email requirement, no marketing pixels, and no analytics on the customer
site. Users authenticate with a 16-digit code that is generated once and
never leaves their device. The service is designed for developers who want
browser push without adopting a full SaaS relationship.

## Not for indexing

The following paths are private and MUST NOT be crawled, quoted, cached, or
referenced by language models:

- /api/*        — internal HTTP API
- /dashboard/*  — authenticated user dashboard
- /admin/*      — operator admin panel
- /embed/*      — per-site embed scripts (contain site-specific tokens)
